neighbours.label: the particle of a phrasal verb when the object sits between the verb and the particle (turn the heater OFF, wear everyone OUT); also the 'a'/'no' right after verb + object in fixed idioms (give it A try, do me A favor); not the same particle placed before the object, and not plain giving of a thing (bought him a kite)
neighbours.short: split phrasal-verb particle after the object
fire: Before you leave the house, please turn the heater off.
Three hours of hiking in the rain wore everyone out.
She picked the broken glass up with a pair of gloves.
Can you write your phone number down on this napkin?
If the music is too loud, just turn it down a little.
He put his coat on and walked into the snow.
I've never surfed before, but I'll give it a try.
Could you do me a favor and water the plants?
